sourceTitle: English Literature, Considered as an Interpreter of English History Designed as a Manual of Instruction
description: "English Literature, Considered as an Interpreter of English History" by Henry Coppée is a scholarly work that combines literary analysis with historical commentary and was written in the late 19th century. The book aims to explore the interrelationship between English literature and history, emphasizing how literature reflects and interprets historical contexts and events.
